items.title: Jensen Huang Just Got His Nvidia Job Back. When Steve Jobs, Howard Schultz and Bob Iger Came Back, the Stock Rose, and a Year Later 4 of 6 Comebacks Trailed the Market
items.summary: Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO 12 days after he resigned. In six earlier comebacks by a founder or defining CEO, from Steve Jobs at Apple to Bob Iger at Disney, the stock rose the next day five times, trailed the S&P 500 a year later four times, and beat it over five years in three of four.
